title: BPW-2026-0495
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0495
BOE + BOS
CD 11
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – XYLEM WATER SOLUTIONS USA, INC.
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation to sole source the selection of Xylem Water Solutions USA, Inc., the Original Equipment Manufacturer of the existing Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant (HWRP) Effluent Pumping Plant (EPP) Xylem Flygt Allis-Chalmers® 2500 Horse Power Custom Vertical Turbine Pump (VTP) Trains, for the HWRP EPP Five Pump Trains Equipment Procurement project, consisting of the procurement of five 2500 HP Variable Frequency Drives, five 2500 HP motors, 3/60/4800V, 20 Pole, inverter duty, five Xylem Flygt Allis-Chalmers® Custom VTPs Refurbishment, and services including engineering and project management, factory inspections, installation inspections and approvals and start up assistance for an amount not-to-exceed $21,230,000, including contingency; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to negotiate a price agreement with Xylem Water Solutions USA, Inc. for the above-referenced procurement of equipment and services and return to the Board with a recommendation for the award.
(W.O.: SZH12244)
summary: Sole source procurement authorization for Xylem Water Solutions USA, Inc. to supply equipment and services for Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant in Council District 11 for $21,230,000.
